User-agent: *
Allow: /

# Signed-in surfaces. Listed with and without the .html extension because the
# host may serve either form, and a rule that only covers one is a rule that
# does not work.
Disallow: /app.html
Disallow: /app
Disallow: /login.html
Disallow: /login
Disallow: /account.html
Disallow: /account
Disallow: /checkout.html
Disallow: /checkout
